_comment: EXAMPLE GM SecurityAccess key map -- PLACEHOLDER KEYS ONLY, do not use.
_format: {ecuid_hex: aes128_key_hex}. ECUID is the 16-byte 0x27 0x01 seed prefix. Key is 16 bytes (AES-128). Keys beginning with '_' are ignored.
_domain_note: One key is shared across an ECUID domain (suffix); see DOMAIN_SUFFIXES in security_cmac.py. The ECUIDs below use real domain suffixes but fabricated prefixes.
_usage: Copy to a git-ignored path (e.g. ~/.config/mdi2/keys.json) and fill in real keys captured separately. Load via GMSecurityAccess(key_map_path) or the --key-map CLI option. NEVER commit real keys.
